goal: Add a daily, deterministic synthetic crawler availability check without changing the active homepage metadata cohort.
summary: Adds a production monitor that fetches the homepage with Googlebot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot user-agent strings. It fails on a non-200 response, non-HTML response, missing canonical homepage link, or missing raw HTML h1. The existing daily Production SEO verify workflow runs it after the canonical verifier.
risk: Low: the change adds a read-only GitHub Actions check and a local command; it changes no public page, metadata, analytics event, cost, or production configuration.
requested_actions: Confirm each declared synthetic user-agent probe requires HTTP 200, text/html, a homepage canonical, and an h1 in the raw response.
Confirm an HTTP 403 challenge is a failing negative control rather than a passing crawler-access result.
Confirm the monitor's output states its limit: user-agent spoofing does not prove treatment from a verified crawler IP range.

evidence.obsidian_context: The active CTR cohort and this independent monitor are recorded in client-esteban-media/wiki/esteban-nonbrand-ctr-read-2026-10-20.md and client-esteban-media/wiki/esteban-crawler-availability-monitor-2026-10-20.md.

evidence.hard_stops_checked: No public page, title, description, contact path, analytics event, money movement, DNS, or production configuration change is included. The workflow is a read-only $0 availability check.
evidence.reviewer_ensemble: Builder implemented the isolated monitor and workflow hook. Skeptic review is the explicit HTTP 403 negative-control assertion plus the complete project test suite. Taste review found no user-facing visual or copy change; the monitor reports its limitation rather than presenting a synthetic user agent as crawler proof.
evidence.reviewer_disagreement_reviewed: No reviewer disagreement occurred. The initial literal canonical assertion failed against the live slash-normalized canonical response; the implementation was corrected to parse the canonical href and the live probe and tests were rerun.
evidence.winner_rationale: A separate raw-HTML availability monitor protects discovery surfaces without stacking another title or description change onto the homepage CTR cohort before its scheduled 2026-11-06 read.
evidence.tests_or_validation: Focused monitor tests passed 3/3, including a simulated HTTP 403 challenge that fails closed. pnpm test passed 163 files / 3,530 tests. pnpm lint passed with 0 errors and existing warnings only. pnpm typecheck passed. pnpm build passed. Live pre-merge command pnpm seo:crawler-availability -- --json returned HTTP 200 and text/html for Googlebot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot.
